stages.name: Backward mining of +$1 winners
stages.detail: 183/183 Discovery days mined; single-state enrichment census complete.
stages.finding: All 810 exact MT5 states are measured against hit and non-hit controls across both directions, nine horizons and six Discovery blocks.

stages.name: MT5 precursor discovery
